checks.observed: The official @deepseek-ai/dsh Web profile served its upstream index and loaded the AI-AR client module through the same page.
The one-time DSH URL exchanged for an HttpOnly browser cookie; the AR workbench did not require a user login or API-key onboarding flow.
Authenticated overview, runs, CodeAgent catalog, RAG status and debug status returned HTTP 200 on the official DSH port.
Claude Code provider and Codex CLI were available in the WSL DSH process; OpenCode, Cursor and Trae remained explicitly missing and non-dispatchable.

A real Codex CLI child was started through the official AR route, recorded in runtime SQLite supervised_processes, cancelled through the route, reaped, and finalized as cancelled with an auditable attempt.
RAG returned a stale/planned state with lexical fallback metadata, while debug returned a partial artifact scan and an explicit missing hdc target.

scope_limits: The current DSH process runs a trusted local WSL workspace on loopback; public multi-tenant identity, WSS and mTLS are not enabled.
This workspace is the platform repository rather than an OpenHarmony or HarmonyOS product root, so its AR run remains deterministically blocked or cancelled at environment validation.
No connected hdc device or production Qwen embedding/reranker endpoint was available during this smoke.
